title: formula: label(record.FIELD) on a field that declares no options is admitted at the active authoring door, then reads null on every row
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filed by the PM seat for the W3-RT runner `session_017xRBcRX4wwwVw5bEckffdp`, whose own write was refused by its session permissions (RUNNER rule 2: staged text, posted verbatim through the same door).

QA-source: #28656 · api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

The active object-authoring door refuses a formula that names an unknown field (`label(record.nope)` → 422 `expression-invalid`) or calls an unregistered function (`sqrt(4)` → 422). But `label()` pointed at a field that exists and declares no options (a text field) is admitted with 200. Every row then reads the formula as `null`, and a WARN line appears in the server log. A compound expression goes through the same way: `label(record.kind) + label(record.first)` → 200.

**Expected:** refused at author time with 422 `expression-invalid` naming the field. The door has the object schema in hand, and `label()` is only meaningful on a select or option-bearing field.

Measured at framework `6e11a929` (main, 2026-11-01), on a stock showcase boot with a runtime-installed scratch package.

## Reproduction

1. As admin, install a writable scratch package: `POST /api/v1/packages` with manifest `{"id":"com.objectstack.qa.formula","namespace":"qaformula",…}` and `enableOnInstall` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qaformula_p4?package=com.objectstack.qa.formula` with `{"name":"qaformula_p4","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"first":{"type":"text"},"kind":{"type":"select","options":[{"value":"clean","label":"Clean"}]},"pf":{"type":"formula","expression":"label(record.first)"}}}` → **200** (expected 422).
3. `POST /api/v1/data/qaformula_p4` `{"first":"hello","kind":"clean"}` → 201 with `"pf": null`. The boot log shows WARN "formula field 'pf' on 'qaformula_p4' could not be evaluated … `first` declares no options".

## Mechanism

No lint or expression rule checks the target of `label()` (a grep of `packages/lint/src` finds no label-target or option check). The refusal exists only at evaluate time, in `optionLabelOf` in `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` (around L412–417). The authoring gate (`expression-invalid`, #22019) type-checks the call and does not look up whether its field argument carries options.

Not a reopen of #22019, which covered unregistered functions; this is a registered macro pointed at the wrong kind of field. Related: #26608 introduced `label()`.
